$comment: Enforces docs/licensing-policy.md. Production dependencies must use an allowed licence. Dev tooling may also use review licences but never a banned one.
$exceptionsComment: Workspace packages are our own code. Add third-party exceptions only with a reason and a docs/dependencies.md entry.
$reviewComment: WTFPL: maximally permissive and allows commercial use; accepted for build tooling only (electron-builder -> sanitize-filename -> truncate-utf8-bytes), never for shipped code, because its informal wording makes some legal reviewers uneasy.
